title: Petition of Kenneth L. Hoggard requesting that the Department of Public Utilities issue him a temporary license, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 5, for the operation of motor vehicles over certain public ways in Boston, Lexington, Waltham, Weston, Newton, Wellesley, Needham, Dedham, Westwood and certain public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority.
